name: cartorium-fishing-guild
title: The Fisher King's Guild
description: The Fisher King's Guild is a social hub built entirely on status, and the only currency that matters is fish. There's no correct order to move through it and no wrong door to walk through, just one rule everyone takes dead seriously: if you want in, you'd better have caught something good. Includes a day and a rainy-night version of the map, pre-placed NPCs and GM notes. Requires the D&D 5e system.
